        %{changeset | action_type: :destroy}

        Ash.Changeset.for_destroy(%{changeset | action_type: :destroy}, action.name, %{},
          actor: opts[:actor],

defmodule Forum.Archive.Preparations.ArchiveScope do
  @moduledoc """
  A read preparation that scopes a read to archived records or live records.

  Supports `type: :archived` (only archived) and `type: :live` (default, only
  live). Use `type: :all` to leave the read unconstrained.

  Referenced by the `:read`, `:archived` and `:with_archived` actions of the forum
  resources.
  """
  use Ash.Resource.Preparation

  @impl Ash.Resource.Preparation
  def prepare(query, opts, _context) do
    type = Keyword.get(opts, :type, :live)

    case type do
      :archived ->
        Ash.Query.filter(query, not is_nil(archived_at))

      :live ->
        Ash.Query.filter(query, is_nil(archived_at))

      :all ->
        query
    end
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeArchive do
  @moduledoc """
  Archives the target record and all its non-archived descendants into the same
  generation under one new `archive_batch_id`.
  """
  use Ash.Resource.Change

  alias Ash.Resource.Info

  @impl Ash.Resource.Change
  def change(changeset, _opts, context) do
    # Only proceed if the record is not already archived.
    case changesets_current_archived_at(changeset) do
      nil ->
        batch_id = UUID.uuid4()
        now = DateTime.utc_now()
        changeset = changeset
          |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archived_at, now)
          |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archive_batch_id, batch_id)
        Ash.Changeset.after_action(changeset, fn _cs, record ->
          cascade(record, now, batch_id)
          {:ok, record}
        end)
      _already_archived ->
        changeset
    end
  end

  defp changesets_current_archived_at(%{data: %{archived_at: at}}), do: at
  defp changesets_current_archived_at(%{attributes: attrs}), do: attrs[:archived_at]

  defp cascade(nil, _now, _batch_id), do: :ok
  defp cascade(record, now, batch_id) do
    resource = record.__struct__
    for rel <- Info.relationships(resource) || [] do
      destination = rel.destination
      if Info.resource?(destination, :archived_at) do
        case Ash.load(record, rel.name, authorize?: false) do
          {:ok, %{^rel => children}} when is_list(children) ->
            for child <- children do
              # Skip already archived descendants.
              if child.archived_at == nil do
                Ash.update!(
                  Ash.Changeset.for_update(child, :archive_cascade, %{}, authorize?: false)
                  |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archived_at, now)
                  |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archive_batch_id, batch_id),
                  authorize?: false
                )
                cascade(child, now, batch_id)
              end
            end
          {:ok, %{^rel => child}} when child != nil ->
            if child.archived_at == nil do
              Ash.update!(
                Ash.Changeset.for_update(child, :archive_cascade, %{}, authorize?: false)
                |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archived_at, now)
                |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archive_batch_id, batch_id),
                authorize?: false
              )
              cascade(child, now, batch_id)
            end
          _otherwise ->
            :ok
        end
      end
    end
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeRestore do
  @moduledoc """
  Restores an archived record and all its descendants that share the record's
  (pre-restore) batch ID.
  """
  use Ash.Resource.Change

  alias Ash.Resource.Info

  @impl Ash.Resource.Change
  def change(changeset, _opts, context) do
    data = changeset.data
    batch_id = data.archive_batch_id

    case {data.archived_at, batch_id} do
      {archived_at, batch_id} when not is_nil(archived_at) and not is_nil(batch_id) ->
        changeset
        |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archived_at, nil)
        |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archive_batch_id, nil)
        |> Ash.Changeset.after_action(fn _cs, record ->
          cascade(record, batch_id)
          {:ok, record}
        end)
      _otherwise ->
        changeset
    end
  end

  defp cascade(nil, _batch_id), do: :ok
  defp cascade(record, batch_id) do
    resource = record.__struct__
    for rel <- Info.relationships(resource) || [] do
      destination = rel.destination
      if Info.resource?(destination, :archived_at) do
        case Ash.load(record, rel.name, authorize?: false) do
          {:ok, %{^rel => children}} when is_list(children) ->
            for child <- children do
              # Only restore descendants with the matching batch ID.
              if child.archive_batch_id == batch_id do
                Ash.update!(
                  Ash.Changeset.for_update(child, :restore_cascade, %{}, authorize?: false)
                  |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archived_at, nil)
                  |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archive_batch_id, nil),
                  authorize?: false
                )
                cascade(child, batch_id)
              end
            end
          {:ok, %{^rel => child}} when child != nil ->
            if child.archive_batch_id == batch_id do
              Ash.update!(
                Ash.Changeset.for_update(child, :restore_cascade, %{}, authorize?: false)
                |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archived_at, nil)
                |> Ash.Changeset.force_change(:archive_batch_id, nil),
                  authorize?: false
                )
              cascade(child, batch_id)
            end
          _otherwise ->
            :ok
        end
      end
    end
    :ok
  end
end
